purpose: Decompose the post-MSDA encoder bottlenecks: fusion internals and remaining deformable-layer projections/FFN.
methodology_note: Each group is profiled in a separate forward pass set. Hooks synchronize PyTorch MPS and MLX at module boundaries and therefore perturb scheduling. Sums of medians are diagnostic only and are not additive GPU timelines. Experiment 0009 remains the authoritative uninstrumented latency.
